text:
maya.l: Heads-up: hit a confusing error during onboarding today. CLI showed `ApiError: Unauthorized` but network trace shows 429. Worker retried the wrong path and rate-limited us.

jonah: Oof. Surprise mismatch between message text and HTTP status is the worst for background jobs.

tara.s: We should standardize error shape across SDKs: keep ApiError base, add explicit subclasses (AuthError, PermissionError, RateLimitError, ServerError) and add fields: `http_status` (int), `error_code` (string), `retry_after` (int seconds, optional), and `human_hint` (short actionable text).

sam.j: +1. Also: error_code examples: `auth.expired`, `perm.missing_scope`, `rate.exceeded`, `server.temporary`. Machine codes let integrations avoid brittle string-matches.

maya.l: Can we also include a boolean `transient` or `should_retry` hint? That would make worker plumbing much simpler.

tara.s: Yes — either `should_retry` or `retry_policy` enum. Start simple with `should_retry: true|false` and `retry_after` if true.

jonah: Parity note: make sure Py/JS/Go expose the same fields and exception classes. Keep ApiError so existing try/except still works. New subclasses are opt-in but recommended.

sam.j: UX copy suggestion for sample-apps: show three patterns: refresh-on-auth, backoff-on-rate-limit (use retry_after), fail-fast-on-permissions. Include code snippets for each language.

maya.l: Also add linters/tests in sample-apps to flag string-matching on error.message. Add a migration note to warn callers relying on message text and offer the `error_code` shim for one release.

devex-bot: created DE-3001: "sdk:error-contracts-actionable-hints" and assigned to @tara.s.

jonah: I'll help review the RFC and run the parity tests across languages. Thanks for raising this, maya.

maya.l: thanks everyone — leaving this thread for visibility; ping me when the RFC lands. :rocket:
